title: Obwenkanya Mu Basuubuzi
intro: Omutindo gwayimirira mu maaso g’abantu abaali bamaze okusikiriza amagoba, ng’abayita okuba abeesimbu n’obwenkanya mu nkolagana yaabwe. Omuddu wa Allah ono yalabula ku kuwa ekipimo ekimpi n’okukyusakyusa minzaani. Abantu baagaana okuwuliriza, nga batiisatiisa okugoba omuntu ono ssekinnoomu ku ttaka lyabwe. Ensi yennyini yandisituka mu kusalirwa omusango ku bo. Ffiro eno eyayimirirawo ku bwenkanya mu basuubuzi y’ani?
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’omubaka eri abantu abaali bannyikidde ennyo mu by’obusuubuzi n’ebyobusuubuzi.
Abantu bange baawaayo ekipimo ekimpi nga bapimira abalala ebyamaguzi.
Bantiisatiisa okungoba mu nsi singa nnywerera ku kubayita mu kukkiriza.
Njjukirwa ng’omwogezi asinga okwogera obulungi mu bannabbi.
Abantu bange baakwatiddwa musisi ow’amaanyi eyabaleka nga tebalina bulamu mu maka gaabwe.
Nasindikibwa eri abantu b’e Madyan mu bukiikakkono bwa Hijaz.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Suula mu muliro oguyaka ennyo abantu bange
Yayolekedde obwetaavu bw’okufulumya engamiya enkazi okuva mu lwazi
Yalaba okuzikirizibwa kw’ekibuga kyange eggye lya bamalayika

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Abantu bange babbira mu mataba amangi
Abantu bange baasaasaanyizibwa empewo eyali ekuba enduulu
Nalokoka nga ndi munda mu lubuto lw’ekyennyanja ekinene

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
